industry: Fried Chicken Franchise / Quick Service Restaurant (QSR)

strengths: Founders have veterinary medicine background (ensures high hygiene standards)
weaknesses: Kiosk/mini-resto model limits upselling opportunities (drinks/desserts) compared to KFC
opportunities: Digitization of supply chain to defend margins
threats: Fluctuation in raw chicken prices (commodity pressure)
High competition from global giants and aggressive local franchises

porters_five_forces.competition: High (Saturated market with global players and local franchises)
porters_five_forces.supplier_power: Medium (Scale of 200+ outlets gives bargaining power for feed and chicken costs)
porters_five_forces.threat_of_new_entrants: Medium (Low barrier to entry, but hard to scale to 200+ outlets)
